display_name: Legislation (Jersey) Law 2021 (L.8/2021): the whole Law, both deposited texts, from the seat of the reader of an enactment
subject: legislation-2021
seat: The reader of an enactment: someone who has to know what an enactment means for them, when it bound them, what it lets be done to them, and whether a notice reached them in time. Facts are ones that person could state. Provisions that address only an official are encoded for what they mean to that reader. Officials get no seat.

scope.encoded: The Title, the Long title, Articles 1 to 26, Schedule 1, the placeholders of Articles 24 and 25 and Schedules 2 and 3, and the endnotes of both deposited texts: 250 coverage rows, 156 encoded, 64 inert, 30 out-of-scope, 0 refused as a whole, 0 deferred (NOTES.md section 4). 63 exported questions in the reader's words.
scope.not_encoded: The Interpretation (Jersey) Law 1954 (encoded separately by someone else; not copied); the Act R&O.112/2021 that commenced the Law (not among the sources); the constitution and procedure of the Law Revision Board and the organisation, functions and delegation of the Legislative Drafting Office (out-of-scope with reasons); the States' powers to amend by Regulations (2(5), 11(5), 15(10), 17(6), 23), because the Table of Legislation History records none made.
